problem.name: Directed subgraph-freeness testing
problem.statement_latex: Fix a directed pattern $H$ with $k$ source strongly connected components. Given outgoing-neighbor access to a bounded-outdegree $n$-vertex digraph, distinguish $H$-free graphs from graphs requiring at least $\varepsilon dn$ edge changes to become $H$-free.
problem.statement_text: Fix a directed pattern $H$ with $k$ source strongly connected components. Given outgoing-neighbor access to a bounded-outdegree $n$-vertex digraph, distinguish $H$-free graphs from graphs requiring at least $\varepsilon dn$ edge changes to become $H$-free.
